name: 講師
text:
なんで黛さんのデザインをみなさんに紹介したのか
ちゃんとわかってますか？
trans:
Class, do you understand why I've chosen to 
present Mayuzumi-san's design to you all?

name: 講師
text:
ここの襟、フリル、それからリボン
ひとつひとつに意味があり、ストーリーがあるでしょ
trans:
Pay attention to this collar, the frills and the 
ribbons. Each of them were placed there for 
a reason, with a story to tell.

name: 講師
text:
一見突飛なように見えて、ちゃんと統一感は担保してる
衣装デザインとして必然性があるということです
trans:
Although they look erratic at first glance, they
actually maintain the unity of the look. In terms
of costume design, they are in fact necessary.

name: 講師
text:
自分が何を伝えたいのか、自分自身をよく見ましょう
それがコンセプトというものです……わかりますか？
trans:
Reflect upon yourselves and clarify what it is that
you wish to communicate. That's how you
arrive at a concept... do you understand?

name: 冬優子
text:
あーあ、目立ちすぎないようにって
気をつけてたのに…………
trans:
Aargh, after all that effort to not
stand out so much...

name: 冬優子
text:
これじゃ、ふゆ
ガリ勉みたいじゃない
trans: Now I look like a try-hard nerd.

name: 冬優子
text: なんでふゆ、あんなデザインに…………
trans: How did I end up with, that design...

name: 同級生１
text:
ふゆちゃん、すごいね！
先生、ベタ褒めだったじゃん
trans:
Fuyu-chan, you're amazing!
The teacher couldn't stop singing your praises.

name: 冬優子
text: そんなことないって～！
trans: Oh no, not at all~!

name: 同級生２
text:
あるある
アイツ、全然褒めないで有名なんだから
trans:
Yes, you are.
That guy's famous for being hard to please.

name: 同級生３
text: ……私は褒められたことあるけどね
trans: ... He's praised my work before.

name: 冬優子
text: そうなんだ～
trans: Oh wow～

name: 同級生２
text: 黛さん、やっぱ服飾志望なの？
trans:
So Mayuzumi-san, are you really aiming
to be a designer?

name: 冬優子
text:
ううん……
選択だったから、たまたま取ってただけだよ
trans:
No...
I just randomly took this as my elective.

name: 同級生１
text:
えーっ！
たまたまでそれってすごくない？
trans:
Whoa!
Isn't it even more awesome that you can
come up with something like that "randomly"?

name: 冬優子
text:
あー…………
あんまり持ち上げすぎないで
trans:
Aaagh...
Don't sing my praises so much.

name: 同級生１
text:
続けないの、もったいないよねぇ？
ふゆちゃん適性あるのに
trans:
It'd be a waste not to continue, don't you think?
You're really suited for it, Fuyu-chan.

name: 冬優子
text: もー、大袈裟だよ～
trans: Aww, you're exaggerating~

name: 同級生３
text:
……いいよね、黛さんのデザイン
教科書通りっていうか、お行儀いい感じで
trans:
... I guess Mayuzumi-san's design is good.
It feels like a textbook example that stays 
neatly within the lines.

name: 冬優子
text:
結局、相手しなきゃいけなくなるのは
ふゆなんだから
trans:
Because at the end of the day, I'm the one 
who has to deal with these kind of people.

name: 同級生１
text:
ね、先生も言ってたよね！
ふゆちゃんのデザイン、お手本みたいだって
trans:
Right, the teacher said so too!
Fuyu-chan's design is like a model example 
to follow.

name: 同級生３
text:
……基本を押さえてる感、アピったほうが
あの先生にはウケがいいからねー
trans:
... Showing off that you've mastered the basics
always goes over well with that teacher.

name: 冬優子
text:
……無様ねえ
他人を下げないと自分を保てないやつって
trans:
... So pathetic.
Someone who can't maintain her self-esteem
without dragging other people down.

name: 冬優子
text:
教科書通りにすらできないくせに
自分は棚に上げるのよね、こういうタイプ
trans:
This type of person can't even see her 
own faults, but fails to follow basic textbook
instructions.

name: 冬優子
text:
そうなんだ～
ふゆ、先生のことよく知らなくて……
trans:
Oh, is that so～
Fuyu didn't really know much about the
teacher...

name: 同級生３
text:
……あの講師、芸術家肌とは相性悪いから
私みたいなタイプ、なかなか評価されないんだよね
trans:
... That instructor doesn't really gel well with 
true artistic types, so people like me 
don't get the appreciation we deserve.

name: 冬優子
text:
そっかぁ、勉強になるな～
ふゆ、全然評価されようと思ってやってなかったから
trans:
Wow, that's useful to know～
Fuyu didn't really think about being 
appreciated while doing her work.

name: 冬優子
text:
ばーか……基本ができてないから
功を焦って奇をてらったり、小細工に走るのよ
trans:
What an idiot... It's because you don't have
the basics down that you resort to cheap 
gimmicks and contrarian ideas to succeed.

name: 冬優子
text:
自惚れてる暇があるんだったら
やることやってから僻みなさい
trans:
If you have time to toot your own horn,
do your own homework before you come at me.

name: 同級生２
text:
じゃあ、進路はどうするの？
何かやりたいこととかさ
trans:
So, have you thought about your future plans?
Like what you'd like to do as a career, and 
stuff.

name: 冬優子
text:
みんなと一緒だよ？
ふゆもまだ迷ってて……
trans:
Fuyu's the same as everyone, though?
Still not sure...

name: 同級生１
text: ていうか、ふゆちゃんって可愛いよね？
trans:
Now that you mention it, Fuyu-chan's really
cute, right?

name: 同級生１
text:
スタイルいいし、肌めっちゃ綺麗だし、お人形みたい！
そっち系の仕事とかも、いけるんじゃない？
trans:
She's got good proportions and nice skin, just
like a doll! She could even make use of it and 
do that kind of work, don't you think?

name: 冬優子
text:
え、ええっ……？
ちょっと、褒めすぎだよ～
trans:
Uh, huh...?
Stop, you're praising me too much～

name: 同級生２
text:
そっち側でもいけそうだよね、全然
黛さんだったら
trans:
If it's Mayuzumi-san, she could really make
it work on the other side of the runway.

name: 冬優子
text: …………そっち側
trans: ... The other side?

name: 同級生３
text: ……そんな可愛いなら、アイドルにでもなれば？
trans:
... If you think you're that cute, why not 
become an idol or something?

name: 同級生３
text:
…………あっ、あの
いい意味でっていうか……
trans:
... Ah, umm...
I meant it in a good way...

name: 冬優子
text: …………アイドル？
trans: ...... An idol?

name: 同級生１
text:
ふゆちゃんなら、きっとなれるよ
アイドル！
trans:
Fuyu-chan, you could totally pull off
being an idol!

name: 冬優子
text: そんな…………アイドルって……
trans: There's no way... an idol...

name: 冬優子
trans: ... Me, an idol?

name: 冬優子
trans: ... Fuyu is...

name: 同級生１
text:
なんか楽しみ～！
同じクラスの子がアイドルになるって
trans:
I can't wait to see it～!
Someone from my class becoming an idol!

name: 冬優子
text:
…………も～っ！
それより、ほら……課題やるんでしょ？
trans:
...... Geez～!
Rather than that, come on... We've got an
assignment to do, right?

name: 冬優子
text:
可愛くて、かっこよくて
キラキラして…………
trans:
Pretty, and cool,
and dazzling...

name: 冬優子
trans: And special...
